prior: Calgary autocorrelation is near white noise beyond one step (lag-1 0.355, lag-120 0.070, lag-480 0.053, weekly 0.051 vs ClarkNet 0.731/0.544/0.481/0.455) with ~6x the coefficient of variation. Expected outcome: no gain on the selection-fold gate; a null result is a reportable finding, not a failure. Per-epoch stage-A validation loss is recorded.
protocol: experiment.tuning.splits (frozen); no local split or normalizer math

series_construction.calgary: load_series('calgary', 'counts') - raw counts per 15 s bucket
series_construction.clarknet_cv: load_series('clarknet', 'counts') - counts per 15 s bucket (splits reference units)
series_construction.clarknet_deployment: load_series('clarknet', 'rps', scale_factor=33.0) - served amplitude; scale applied after unit conversion
series_construction.unit_note: split-module references are counts/15s; divide by 15 for RPS; the deployment arm is 33x the rps series

calgary_stats.near_zero_handling: zero buckets kept as 0 counts (genuine empty buckets, complete grid); no interpolation, no dropping; log1p+median/IQR with the std fallback (IQR is zero at 84% zeros) normalises them

stage_a.levers: cross-corpus pretraining only; architecture and protocol identical

amplitude_handling.clarknet_deployment: load_series('clarknet','rps') x manifest scale_factor 33.0 (unit chain: counts/15s -> /15 RPS -> x33 served)
amplitude_handling.reconciliation: per-arm normalizer_stats fits on the training region only

skipped_blocks.reason: train [0, 34522) would contain the replay window (28940, 29020); forbidden by the replay-placement rule

serving_note: final artifacts embed the log1p median/IQR (std-fallback) transform in their window pipeline; promoting to serving requires porting that transform into the serving path

reported_separately.note: b5 and the deployment split are reported per fold; never in the selection aggregate
